title: Oda Nobunaga wins the Battle of Okehazama
summary: Oda Nobunaga's small force made a surprise attack during a rainstorm on the camp of the warlord Imagawa Yoshimoto, who was killed.
reason: Imagawa was marching on Kyoto with a large army and had invaded Nobunaga's province of Owari.
significance: The upset made Nobunaga a leading warlord and began the unification of Japan.
